deployments_detail.use: AI across life sciences/diagnostics; Leica Biosystems AI-powered digital pathology suite; AI for biomanufacturing

TriageGO: ML-based clinical decision support tool that integrates with EHR to differentiate emergency department patient criticality and speed triage decisions; developed by Johns Hopkins and used in Johns Hopkins EDs, acquired by Danaher's Beckman Coulter (StoCastic acquisition). [Beckman Coulter (StoCastic); Johns Hopkins Medicine]
deployments_detail.value: decreases door-to-clinical decision time by 20-30 minutes, door-to-ICU times by 40-80 minutes, door-to-ED departure for emergency surgery by 30-60 minutes

deployments_detail.use: Aperio AI Store: live curated marketplace of AI digital-pathology apps embedded in Aperio HALO AP software for whole-slide tissue image analysis, with third-party AI apps (Indica Labs, Lunit, Deep Bio, MindPeak, Histofy, DiaDeep). [Leica Biosystems (Danaher); Indica Labs, Lunit, Deep Bio, MindPeak, Histofy, DiaDeep]

Aperio HALO AP Dx with Aperio GT 450 DX scanner: FDA 510(k)-cleared, browser-based enterprise digital pathology platform (developed with Indica Labs) for primary diagnosis; selected/deployed by South West London Pathology trusts for clinical practice. [Leica Biosystems (Danaher); Indica Labs]

SCIEX AI Quantitation software: AI/ML tool (developed with Mass Analytica) that automates MS/MS mass spectrometry method optimization, uses a learning-to-rank model to predict MRM product ions, and automates quantitation workflows; available product. [SCIEX (Danaher); Mass Analytica]

SCIEX OS 5.0 software with AI enablement tools, launched on the novus V55 system: includes an AI-enabled natural-language 'helpme' function that answers feature/functionality questions and AI-driven data-processing and fleet-management tools for mass spectrometry. [SCIEX (Danaher)]

CellXpress.ai: launched automated 3D cell culture system for drug discovery using integrated AI-powered / machine-learning software to make flexible feeding and passaging decisions; early adopters (e.g. HeartBeat.bio) using it. [Molecular Devices (Danaher)]
CellXpress.ai upgrade adding rocking incubation enabling automated brain organoid culture and improved AI-driven workflows for 3D biology drug discovery. [Molecular Devices (Danaher)]

Beckman Coulter Diagnostics selects Innovaccer Gravity as its AI and data platform to modernize clinical laboratory operations, unifying diagnostic/operational data for AI-ready insights and test-utilization optimization. [Beckman Coulter (Danaher); Innovaccer]

Danaher-AstraZeneca precision medicine partnership to develop AI-assisted algorithms and digital/computational pathology diagnostic products (built on Leica Biosystems digital pathology) to identify patients for targeted therapies, via Danaher's Centers for Enabling Precision Medicine. [Danaher / Leica Biosystems; AstraZeneca]

Molecular Devices partners with Automata's LINQ automation platform to deliver AI-ready automated research workflows integrating its imaging and detection instruments. [Molecular Devices (Danaher); Automata]
Danaher investment partnership in healthcare AI company Innovaccer to advance AI-enabled diagnostics and precision-medicine data solutions. [Danaher; Innovaccer]
